notes.title: Killer Depths: Ready to Descend!
notes.content: [h3]The abyss beckons.[/h3][p]Killer Depths launches today, August 21st 2025. The second title by our small team at Stardust Smithy, Killer Depths promises an eerie atmosphere, pensive moments of observation and tense spikes of panic. For those brave enough to delve into the abyss, we hope you enjoy your stay, and that you never leave.[/p]
